noise_policy: Retain nominal sigma0 and attach noise diagnostics separately. No corrected HV substitution, floor masking or automatic candidate rejection.
crop: Integer centre ((x0+x1)//2,(y0+y1)//2), half-open source bbox; 37 pixels before centre, 37 after. Require complete 75x75 context and entire bbox inside crop.
incidence_policy: Finite centre incidence strictly between 0 and 90 degrees; retain exact value and acquisition metadata. No transfer-validity claim from angle overlap.
selection_basis: Conservative preservation of existing nominal native pixels and reversible identity normalization, not chosen by class scores or validation performance. Diagnostic development images were previously inspected.
future_fit: Separate authorized versioned experiment with admitted training-role labels; normalization or noise changes require a new contract frozen before validation.
